{"article_id":"Art. 30","resource_uri":"onedrive://legal/contracts/sms-otp-smsnord.md","start":1,"end":40,"quote":"3: # SMS and One-Time Password Delivery Agreement
5: Parties: PayRo SRL and SMSNord Telecom SRL
6: Contract ID: CTR-2022-007
7: Status: active · Effective: 2022-06-15 · Renewal: 2026-06-15
8: Services: delivery of one-time passwords used to authorise transfers

13: ## 1. Services and functions
14: The Provider delivers SMS one-time passwords for PayRo customers. Subcontracting is permitted with notice to PayRo.
16: ## 2. Locations of data processing
17: Messages are processed in Romania and Estonia. The Provider notifies PayRo before changing a location.
19: ## 3. Data protection
20: The Provider protects the availability, authenticity, integrity and confidentiality of message data, including phone numbers.
22: ## 4. Access, recovery and return of data
23: On termination or insolvency PayRo can access and recover delivery logs, returned in an easily accessible format.
25: ## 5. Service levels
26: Service level: 99.5% delivery within 10 seconds, measured monthly, with precise quantitative targets and service credits.
28: ## 6. Assistance in ICT incidents
29: The Provider assists PayRo during an ICT incident at a cost determined ex-ante in Annex 2.
31: ## 7. Cooperation with competent authorities
32: The Provider cooperates fully with PayRo's competent authorities and resolution authorities.
34: ## 8. Termination
35: Either party may terminate with 60 days' notice.
37: ## 9. Security awareness and training
38: Provider staff attend PayRo's ICT security awareness programmes and resilience training on request.
40: ## 10. Notice and reporting obligations
40: The Provider reports any development that may affect the agreed service levels.","obligation":"The SMS and One-Time Password Delivery Agreement is missing the Art. 30 clause on assistance in ICT incidents at no additional cost or at a cost determined ex-ante; this must be updated to comply with the Regulation.","action":"CONTRACT_REVIEW","confidence":0.9}
